title: Star Trek (The Original Series)
creator: Gene Roddenberry
invention: The flip-open communicator, the tricorder, the hypospray

tech.name: Motorola DynaTAC
tech.description: The first handheld cell phone, demonstrated in New York in 1973. Cooper once credited Star Trek, then later said his inspiration was Dick Tracy's wrist radio.

tech.name: Space Shuttle Enterprise
tech.description: Planned as "Constitution", the first shuttle was renamed after a letter campaign by Star Trek fans. Roddenberry and most of the cast attended the rollout.

references.title: Frances Lewine, "Star Trek Fans Win on Space Shuttle," The Lewiston Daily Sun, p. 20
Mark Strauss, "Declassified Memos Reveal Debate Over Naming the Shuttle 'Enterprise'," io9

tech.name: QuickTime
tech.description: Apple's video software. Perlman said an episode of Star Trek: The Next Generation inspired it, in the 2005 documentary How William Shatner Changed the World.

references.title: How William Shatner Changed the World (documentary)

tech.name: iPhone 4
tech.description: A five-year competition named after the tricorder to build a handheld diagnostic device. Final Frontier Medical Devices of Philadelphia won the $2.5 million first prize.

references.title: Benjamin Caine, "Big Tech’s Incomplete Reverence for Star Trek," Medium

tech.maker: XPRIZE / Qualcomm; won by Final Frontier Medical Devices
